status: Runtime contextual landscape dressing and authored building condition

layout.grass: 81 ternary NW/NE/SW/SE corner patterns (meadow/lush/dry), two surfaces each
layout.paths: (condition * 4 + surface) * 17 + N1/E2/S4/W8 mask; cell 16 is full dirt for wide-road interiors
layout.water: shared deep-water corner mask * 3 + ripple variant
layout.flora: flowers 0..7, grass 8..15, reeds 16..19, leaf beds 20..27, debris 28..31, moss 32..35, sparse leaves 36..39
layout.walls: condition * 24 + panel variant * 12 + original kit part

building.workshop.001.repairs: localized fresh plaster, replacement beam and one roof patch

provenance.creator: Codex-assisted native pixel authoring in LibreSprite for Adam Holland
provenance.notes: New terrain and flora drawn at native resolution. Building and resource variants derive only from the original project masters; those originals are preserved.
